high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the India Today app. The top section features an advertisement for Amity University's Best Colleges Survey 2025. Below that, there is a headline about a Tripura girl who has been missing in Delhi for six days. The text mentions that there is no CCTV footage, no leads, and no bank activity related to her disappearance. It also notes that following her disappearance, the Delhi Police, along with the National Disaster Response Force, launched a massive search operation within a seven-kilometer radius, but it yielded no results even after a week.
